whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.lead: Rapid Charity is the public face of Reconciliation And Peace Innovative Development (RAPID), a non-political, non-sectarian, non-profit organization registered in the United States of America. We focus on philanthropic goals with a commitment to serving those in need, especially through educational empowerment.
whoWeAre.body: RAPID is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization. Independent nonprofit directories list the legal entity as Reconciliation And Peace Innovative Development - Rapid (EIN 82-2731074), based in Rancho Cucamonga, California.

mission.title: Our mission
paragraphs: Our mission is to promote career-based higher education among talented, qualified, and ambitious young people, assisting them to realize their full potential in deprived and peripheral situations within the Indo-Pakistan context.

To give and distribute donor funding to financially poor and able individuals in need, by making charitable giving positive for purposes of leading to advancement of education in professional and career development, self-reliance, and confidence building.
To encourage activities leading to the implementation of peace, with the goal of building trust and cooperation among different faith communities through joint programs.

To organize, encourage, conduct, and participate in development programs and training courses for promoting the rights and dignity of all people, with emphasis on better utilization of local resources.
To work with medical centers, nursing homes, orphanages, and centers for the mentally and physically disabled, in order to equip and help beneficiaries to acquire quality of life.
For the implementation of its goals, RAPID partners with religious bodies, non-political organizations, and institutions of proven credibility.

whatWeDo.title: What we do
whatWeDo.intro: Our core work is scholarship support for talented youth from marginalized communities who lack the resources to complete career-based higher education. Donations are directed to education costs such as application fees, tuition, and supplies.

awards: Scholarship awards typically range from US$500 to US$5,000 and may support tuition, books, research, and related education expenses.
RAPID scholarships are available to students residing in India and Pakistan for graduate and postgraduate study, with preference for financially needy students with strong academic records.

John-Ivy awards emphasize motivated students in minority communities of Pakistan (for example GPA 3.5+ or 90th percentile) seeking admission to strong professional programs such as law, medicine, engineering, information technology, or CSS.

howItWorks.title: How RAPID works
howItWorks.intro: Scholars are identified with attention to leadership potential, commitment to a professional career, prior academic achievement, and prospects for continued success. A rigorous application and interview process helps assess goals, future impact, and need.

steps.title: Pre-qualify
steps.body: Submit the pre-qualification form on our website when you are deciding on, applying to, or already accepted by a professional school.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: RAPID reviews applications and documents and verifies authenticity. Incomplete applications are not considered.

steps.title: Second stage
steps.body: Shortlisted students receive a second application. RAPID staff correspond with the relevant institution(s).

steps.title: Direct support
steps.body: For selected scholars, arrangements are made for direct reimbursement of payment to the professional institution.

apply.title: Apply for a Scholarship
apply.intro: Rapid Charity is dedicated to supporting students in their educational journey through our scholarship programs. We offer three distinct scholarships, each designed to cater to different fields of study.

programs.heading: 1. John-Ivy Azariah Scholarship
programs.body: The John-Ivy Azariah Scholarship is open to all students except those pursuing a business degree. This scholarship aims to support students in various fields of study, encouraging academic excellence and providing financial assistance to those in need.

programs.heading: 2. Robert Mathais Scholarship (for business students only)
programs.body: The Robert Mathais Scholarship is specifically for students enrolled in business programs. This scholarship is intended to support future business leaders, providing them with the resources they need to succeed in their academic and professional endeavors.

programs.heading: 3. Ivy Azariah Scholarship (for Women only)
programs.body: Ivy Azariah Scholarship: This scholarship is in memory of a dignified woman who was not passionate for the materialistic goods this world had to offer but rather the intangible qualities that can remain on this earth for years to come. “A woman that has the willingness to apply the skills learned for the greater good of the society and while maintaining respect and dignity for herself and those around her demonstrates exemplary behavior. Ivy Azariah believed these qualities were the true measure of success: 1) respect for God, your family and yourself, 2) education and 3) discipline. While she had almost every type of relationship during her time on this earth, the one she valued the most was of her family. She married at a young age and during her time moved to two different countries to be with her family, which required her to learn different languages, customs and culture all while supporting her family in anyway she could; whether that be having a career as a principal or being a caregiver for her grand children. She was strong willed and believed that with God at the center any obstacle could be overcome. For our wonderful grandmother we would like to give this award to an individual that is not looking for just making themselves better but how they could be an important part in the development of others as true success can be measured by the skills that can be passed from generation to generation.”

apply.closing: We look forward to receiving your application and supporting your educational journey. If you have any questions about the application process or eligibility criteria, please feel free to contact us.

listItems: The RAPID Scholarships are available to students residing in India and Pakistan for graduate and postgraduate programs

RAPID team expresses thanks and appreciation to the generous donor of Ivy and John Azariah Scholarship Fund

sections.title: RAPID John-Ivy Azariah Scholarship Fund (Win Full or Partial Scholarship)
paragraphs: John-Ivy Azariah Scholarships are available to high achieving students with financial Requirements in minority communities of Pakistan.
Goals: Encouraging students in rising to top professions in community, state and nation and thereby uplifting the needy students in minority communities of Pakistan.
Qualification:
listItems: Seeking motivated, focused and high achieving students in minority communities of Pakistan
Student who display competitive attitude by scoring highest academic grades (GPA 3.5 & above or 90 percentile)
Student who qualifies for admission to top ranked professional school
Qualify for admission in Law, Medicine, Engineering, Information Technology or CSS etc.
Expressed need for Financial support for tuition/fees.

sections.title: How to Apply for Scholarship
paragraphs: Start the application if you are in the process of deciding, applying, already applied or accepted to professional school. It is recommended that you aim for the top ranking professional institutions. Follow the process below:
orderedItems: Fill out the Pre-Qualification Form on our website just by clicking on the Pre-Qualification form button on the top right corner and click on Submit form once completed.
Once your application and documents are received they will be reviewed and verified for authenticity.
Shortlisted students will receive the second Application.
Correspondence with the Institution/s involved will be conducted by the RAPID staff.
For students who qualify and win scholarship arrangements will be made for direct reimbursement of payment to the professional institution.

johnIvy.title: John-Ivy Azariah Scholarship
paragraphs: The John & Ivy Azariah Scholarship, established by their children, is a beacon of hope for promising Christian Pakistani minority students pursuing higher education. Mr. John Azariah and Mrs. Ivy Azariah, who spent their lives in Pakistan, were inspirational figures in their community.

This scholarship honors their legacy by providing financial support to high-achieving students from minority backgrounds, enabling them to access top-tier educational opportunities and achieve their professional dreams. Through this initiative, the Azariah family’s commitment to education and community upliftment continues to inspire and empower future generations.

robertMathais.title: Robert Mathais Scholarship
paragraphs: Rapid Charity is pleased to introduce Robert Mathias Scholarship for students pursuing graduate studies in Business.
Here is an inspiring story about Mr. Robert Mathias:

“I have the privilege of sharing the story of Robert Mathias, a figure whose legacy continues to inspire many. Born on April 18, 1918, in Gurdaspur, India, Robert chose a path that led him to become an esteemed Accountant and Fiscal Manager. His professional journey, marked by diligence and expertise, was just the beginning of his impact.

Robert held a profound vision for the Christian students at the Christian Institute in Raiwind. He recognized early on the potential within the Christian community to engage more deeply with the business world. Driven by this vision, he dedicated himself to teaching business classes, aiming not just to educate but to instill a professional spirit among the students. His commitment was transformative, nurturing a new generation of Christian professionals.

The impact he had on my sister and me was particularly profound. Under his guidance, we were prepared for the immediate commerce exams, a challenge we might not have tackled successfully without his mentorship. Robert did more than teach; he inspired, he guided, and he believed in us when we needed it most.

Through his efforts at the Christian Institute, he effectively promoted the integration of Christian values with business professionalism, fostering a community of capable and ethical leaders. Robert Mathias wasn’t just an educator; he was a visionary who played a crucial role in shaping the futures of many, including mine. His dedication to developing the concept of a business profession within the Christian community remains a guiding light for all of us who were fortunate enough to be his students.

With this scholarship, it is our hope to continue his memory and legacy, supporting future generations to pursue their professional aspirations with the same spirit and dedication that Robert Mathias championed.”

David Mathias
Son of Robert Mathias
listItems: Only students studying business are eligible to apply.
Students in other fields are not eligible for this scholarship.

donate.intro: Our success, and the success of these talented youth, are entirely dependent on your loving generosity. Make your donation today via credit card. We thank you in advance for your consideration.
dearParagraphs: For families and students seeking to break the cycle of poverty, higher education makes all the difference. However, in these communities, access to higher education is difficult and often financially unattainable. Reconciliation and Peace Innovative Development (RAPID), a 501(c)(3) charitable organization, is focused on supporting talented youth in South Asian countries, who belong to marginalized communities and lack resources, to reach their education potential and fulfill their professional dreams.

RAPID scholars are identified and recommended on the basis of their leadership potential, commitment to a professional career, prior academic achievements, and prospects for continuing academic success. They are then subject to a rigorous application and interview process, which helps assess their goals, future impact, and need. We work diligently to ensure that the chosen group of scholars are worthy and deserving of your support.
Your tax-deductible contribution will go directly towards the education costs, including application fees, tuition, and supplies, for these exceptional individuals.
Our success, and the success of these talented youth, are entirely dependent on your loving generosity. Make your donation today via credit card at our website just by clicking on the Donate button.
